The Hecke operator E_p
Let \alpha_p be the matrix defining the Hecke operator E_p: H^3(\Gamma_0(N), \mathbb C) \to H^3(\Gamma_0(N), \mathbb C), for prime p not dividing N, with \alpha_p = \left(\begin{array}{ccc} p & 0 & 0\\ 0 & 1 & 0\\ 0 & 0 & 1 \end{array}\right) The double coset \Gamma_0(N)\alpha_p \Gamma_0(N) can be decomposed as \coprod_i \beta_i \Gamma_0(N). The function Gamma0_SL3ZHeckeOperator(N,p) computes the action of E_p over \mathbb Z on H_0(\Gamma_0(N),St), using the presentation of Section . It returns the matrix Tfree of E_p on the free part, whose eigenvalues are those of E_p on H^3(\Gamma_0(N),\mathbb C), and the matrix Ttorsion of its action on the torsion part. Note that, in each case, the eigenvalues are exactly p^2+b_p and 1+pb_p, where b_p is the p-th coefficient of the newform of weight 2 and level 11 (associated with the elliptic curve 11a). They correspond to the noncuspidal classes that arise from the Eisenstein liftings (see Example 3.4 of ). Moreover, when N is prime, one has :\dim H^3(\Gamma_0(N),\mathbb C) = \dim H^3_{cusp}(\Gamma_0(N),\mathbb C) + 2\dim S_2(N), where S_2(N) is the space of weight two cusp forms for \Gamma_0(N) \subset SL_2(\mathbb Z). For N=11 we have \dim H^3(\Gamma_0(11),\mathbb C)=2 (Section ) and \dim S_2(11)=1, so there are no cuspidal classes.
For N = 53 we have \dim H^3(\Gamma_0(53),\mathbb C)=10 and \dim S_2(53)=4, so \dim H^3_{cusp}(\Gamma_0(53),\mathbb C)=2. The following computes the factored characteristic polynomial of E_2 for N = 53:
